strings.en: At this range... I can do it!
Corrected 0.2 margin of error! Going in!!
If I can make this a race of speed...!
For Project TD's sake,/　I'll pull this off!
If I make it a race of speed, I can win!
I've survived this long too!/　I know I can do it!
If it's a Lion-type, I can handle it!
Personal Troopers are basically the same/　as Armored Modules!
High-speed combat in the Leonysis... I can do it!
The Cylion is the Calion's successor too!/　I know we can do this...!
Power fights aren't my thing, but...!!
Umm...!/　Whatever, I'll just power through!
I'll tame this kind of unit with Spirit!
I have to draw out the Altalion's power...!
If I can just draw out this unit's power...!
I won't let a Series 77 unit go down!
At this range... the Altalion can do it!
We're in our range! Here's our chance!
Relative speed and distance calculated! Ibis!
We can still do this, Ibis!
Still in range! We can counter!
After every crisis comes a chance!
It's in range! We can counter!
This Hyperlion is our wings to the stars...!
We'll show you our power and the Hyperlion's!
We'll do it! With our own wings!
Target dead ahead! We're making the first move!
Ibis! I'm leaving the piloting to you!
I'll live up to that hope!
I'll draw out the Hyperlion's power!
I'm part of this crew too! All out!
Sleigh! We're going in with a barrel roll!
There's no room for mistakes, Ibis!
Don't think you can outrun the Hyperlion!
I'll pay back every hit in full!
Don't fall behind the likes of the Fury!
I know! Attacking at full speed!
That's an Emperor unit...!/　Its combat power is off the charts!
Gu-Landon! You don't have what/　it takes to lead people!
Gadisword! Don't think you can catch us!
It has no blind spots in any direction!
We'll do it...! With our Hyperlion!
This is the final battle, Captain.
For humanity's tomorrow and for our dream!
I'll defeat XN-L for sure...! With this Hyperlion!
Ibis, don't let its Drive push you back!
My heart will make up for lack of power!
So-Des! I won't lose to someone/　who enjoys fighting!
I'm not playing your little games,/　So-Des!
Jua-Mu! I'll show you an Earthling's pride!
You must have put your effort in the wrong place...!
We've got things we're carrying too...!
Gu-Landon...! If I can just take him down...!
My dream won't lose...!/　Not to a selfish jerk like you!
I don't know what you're after, but...!
You think a Golaikunru mercenary/　can stop us?!
Try to hold us down by force/　all you want...!
If I let them break my rhythm, I lose...!/　I'll fight my own way!
Baran-Schneil...!/　Bringing out something like that!
Gomoudokka!/　You can't stop our dream!
Vort! If you insist on getting in our way...!
Reggiane, I can't afford to waste/　time on you...!
Herluga! I won't let you have your way!
The Cross Gate isn't something/　for you to do as you please with!
No matter how huge it is, there's a way to fight it!
The only joke here is your face, Debudedabide!
I'll finish this before it pulls any weird tricks!
We have to get to Rabulpaila!
Don't think you can stop me now!
Turning our own weapons against us...!
So what if it's possessing a Zovorg unit...!
I'll smash your schemes, body and all!
I won't lose to some skeleton monster...!
Skull Knight! I'll be your opponent!
Your mission and long voyage end here...!/　And humanity will fly through the sea of stars!
We've got all the data on Zovorg units!
If the aliens have come back...!
Like I'd lose to someone I've fought so many times!
I won't lose to Golaikunru's lackeys!
Golaikunru!/　I won't let you have your way!
I won't let you turn Earth into your merchandise!
Earth isn't yours to do with as you like!
Stay out of our planet's affairs!
I won't let you get to those two units!
I'll slip through the gaps in the barrage...!
Fury! I won't lose to you!
I'll draw the Thick Cylinder's attention!
White Horn...! Let's see who's faster!
I'll hold that White Horn off!
Even against a Thorn, if I can/　force it to fight at my pace...!
For now... all I can do is run...!
I can't lose if it comes down to speed!
If my weapons work on it, I can fight it...!
I have to take out the Lamaris...!
Can't let my guard down until it's completely gone...!
Leave the Lamaris in front to me!
They can combine?! You've gotta be kidding...!
Lamaris Kaana! I'll stop you here!
Like we living people would lose to a mass of malice!
Lamaris Ida...!/　I have to beat it here, no matter what...!
If I can just slip past that scythe...!
Why is the Ares Geist here...?!
I'm going to make you hear Arieil's voice!
I have to do something about it/　before Dark Brain is revived...!
I won't take this lying down!
I won't just keep taking hits!
I'll fight to the very last strike!
It can't end in a place like this!!
Don't give in!/　If your heart wavers, you're done for!
I can still counter this much!
Don't flinch! The enemy's still close by!
I won't just sit here and take it!
It won't shake me off! I'll catch up from here!
Not yet! I can't go down yet!!
Ngh...! A-at this rate,/　I'm just waiting to get shot down!
I-I'm gonna get hit.../　At this rate, I'm done for!
This is bad... Any more and...!
I can't handle any more damage...!
Heavy damage! One more hit, at most!
Before then, I have to beat that thing...!
Damage in the red zone!/　Pull back for now!
I can still go... No, I'll prove I can!
Check the damage! I can still fight!
Ngh!/　Is this the Hyperlion's limit!?
Sleigh! Don't go deciding your own limits!
Not good! Tesla Drive output dropping!
Sorry, Sleigh! Hold out a little longer!
Not yet, Herluga! I won't give up!
That black one...! I can't track it!
This isn't working!/　I have to shift to the offensive!
I can't beat its firepower...!/　But I can't fall back...!
Ugh! It's as powerful as it looks...!
Ngh! If the Ida Types keep targeting me...!
Ngh...! I can't dodge it all!
Damage in the yellow zone! At this rate...!
I can still fly! I can still fly!
A-any more hits/　and we'll lose the machine!
B-before I go down,/　I'll land at least one hit!
Taking a direct hit at a time like this...!
If it keeps killing my speed, I'm done for...!
No good!/　Even boosting, I can't shake it!
It got into my blind spot...!
Flight's unaffected! Watch the next shot!
Sorry! I slipped up a little!
The Tesla Drive is still intact!
Not yet... I can still fly!
It's risky, but it's all I can do right now!
Ngh!/　I hate to admit it, but nice hit...!
Even so,/　I won't just sit here and take it!
What are you doing?! Do you want to be a loser again?!
As if! I'll turn this around from here!
Jua-Mu! I can't lose to you!
So this is Al-Van's true strength...?!
Your despair can't shatter our dream!
That's Vort for you...!/　He doesn't miss a single opening...!
Ngh! I have to break free/　of Reggiane's pace...!
If this takes any longer, the Cross Gate will...!
Ugh! The Skull Knight's tactics threw me off!
No! I can't lose to XN-L here...!
Ngh! Our old combat data/　only goes so far...!
Not yet! I'll draw its attacks!
Fury response patterns updated!/　It won't hit me next time!
The Thorn...!/　It attacks with such reckless resolve...!
It's powerful too...! I can't leave it alone...!
Lamaris...! You won't get my soul!
It's even stronger than the Ares Geist...!
Its movements are hard to read!
I can't shake off the Yokijin...!
Not yet! I can handle this much!
It only grazed me! I can still fly!
I can't let a little damage/　like this stop me!
Why...?! Why can't I dodge it?!
A-a little more to the side and/　that would've been fatal...
Ugh... So much for a hair's breadth!
I won't flinch at damage like this!
Even a little damage can be fatal...!/　I have to be careful!
Am I not drawing out/　the Altalion's full power...?!
It hit...! Was that my mistake?!
Calm down, Ibis!/　That one couldn't be helped!
Ignore the damage! Go on the attack...
I know!/　The best defense is a good offense!
Sorry, Tsugumi! I'm counting on you!
That thing's catching up/　to the Hyperlion?!
What are you doing, Ibis? Stay focused!
It's not like I let my guard down...!
You klutz!/　Mess up again and I take the controls!
No way! It won't hit me twice!
Don't get careless! The enemy isn't weak!
Sorry, Sleigh! I'll do better next time!
Is that all you've got, Jua-Mu?!
I can't let Karo-Ran's taunts get to me...!
With skills like these, you call/　yourself the Knight Commander?!
Looks like hitting me is all you can manage, Iradoya!
Vort... If he'd stepped in a little closer...!
Reggiane! Is that really all you've got?!
If I take a direct hit/　from the Florarga, it's over...!
Looks like you're all bark, Crystal Dragoon!
I won't let the likes of you destroy our dream!
Like I'd be shot down by a Zovorg unit!
I knew it. This one won't go down easy...!
It's only a scratch! I'll keep drawing its fire!
That's a Thorn for you...!/　That could've been fatal...!
It doesn't seem to be all that powerful, but...!
Showing fear will only please the Lamaris!
If I don't focus, the Kaana Type will get me...!
Looks like it's faster than before...!
If I read its trajectory,/　I should be able to dodge!
I can do this! The way I am now!
We've got the edge in speed!
When it comes to speed, we're faster!
I trained for that attack pattern!
That's it!/　Don't forget that timing!
Stay sharp! Here comes the next one!
I won't let you wreck our dream machine!
With the Hyperlion, we can do this!
The enemy's slower than I am.
Jua-Mu, attacks like that won't hit me!
If I show Karo-Ran an opening, he'll exploit it...!
Iradoya... Is he just testing the waters...?
Gomoudokka! If you're only half serious...!
I won't lose on speed either!
I can't let the Florarga hit me...!
Unlike you, I'm light on my feet, Debudedabide!
Even the Skull Knight's attacks... if I read their path...!
This is the power of the intelligent life/　you say must perish!
We've fought you guys plenty of times!
Don't think brute force can stop me!
Being a commander unit won't save you!
It's better for me if it targets me...!
I can handle the Fury's movements too!
The Thorn comes at you head-on...!/　If I know that...!
New model or not, I won't go down!
If its attack hits me,/　there's no telling what'll happen...!
I'm not going to let the Lamaris have their way...!
I can't lose to you guys!
I have to watch out for the Kaana Type's power...!
Like I'd let attacks from something so creepy...!
I won't lose to some monster!
All right...!/　It moves just like the Ares Geist!
Okay! At this rate, we can do this!!
I can't get carried away over this!!
If I read its path, I can dodge it!
Nice!/　That's faster than the evasion program!
Nice, Ibis! You're in top form!
I've been growing too, you know.
Not bad... That's what a main pilot does.
Yeah, well... I'll just say thanks.
A trick like this is a given/　for the Hyperlion.
Give my skills some credit too, okay?
This is all thanks to my training with Sleigh!
Heh... Looks like it was of some use.
But maybe I reacted a little late...?
Vort... That was a precise attack, but...!
Th-That attack felt so gross, but...!
Waaaah!/　...Oh, right, I have a barrier...
We've got that kind of gear/　on our side too!
Evasive maneuvers like this are easy!
Once I master the Tesla Drive...!
Not bad... A Break Turn, huh?
Half of that was the Hyperlion's doing.
Did I waste too much ammo!?
No way!/　My weapons can't reach!?
Oh no! The range is off...!
I can at least bring up the rear!
That opening... I won't let it slip!
I can at least provide some backup!
Sleigh! Leave the rest to me!
Lüne! Leave the rest to me!
I won't waste the chance/　Lüne made!
I'll pull off a combination/　with Leona!
Leona! Watch the results of my training!
Masaki! I'll keep up with you!
Kusuha's giving it her all too...!
Okay, Kusuha! Leave the rest to me!
With speed to match the tornado!
Lamia made an opening for me...!
I can't fall behind Lieutenant Katina!
Nice hit, Arado!/　I'm right behind you!
Good work, Arado! I'm right behind you!
I won't waste the opening/　Seolla made!
Way to go, Latune! I'm right behind you!
Latune's amazing.../　I should learn from her!
Hugo, leave the rest to me!
Rim, I'll take it from here!
Doc, leave the rest to me!
Major Sänger, I'm following your lead!
I have to lighten Touya's load!
Calvina! At least let me back you up!
Nice one, Akimi! I'm right behind you!
I won't let Akemi's hard work go to waste!
A fairy and shooting star combination!
I don't really get Filio's taste,/　but...
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I can at least provide some cover!
I'm fine! I'll grit my teeth and take it!
I can at least keep them pinned down!
If I know it's coming, I can take it!
I won't let them get Sleigh!
You're the one I'm aiming to surpass...!
You're charging in too far, Lüne!
I won't let them get Kusuha!
Seolla, you're charging in too far!
I won't let them get Latune!
Calvina! Are you more fired up than you look?!
Akimi! Just charging in won't cut it!
The unit Filio built... I won't let it fall!
I won't let the Exellence go down!
This is why I said we should combine!
We can still do this, Ibis!
Relative speed and distance calculated!/　Loading data!
Going with the Driver! Correct my aim!
The Driver's fast shots will do it!
Tsugumi, we're going with the GRaMXs!
No holding back in close combat!
Going in with the Sonic Saber!
Leave the boost timing to me!
You don't need to tell me!
Size like this comes with power to match!
Tsugumi, Sleigh! We're going with GRaMXs!
Tsugumi, Sleigh!/　Let's bring our strength together as one!
Altalion, fly like a shooting star!!
The timing's the same/　as the Sonic Breaker...!
I'm no good at melee, but I can ram you...!
At this range, this'll do it!
If it hits, I've got this!!
Fire this many and at least one'll hit!/　...Should, anyway!!
No room for timidity up close!
It's got power to match its size!
Let's finish this in one go!
This is no time to lose my nerve!
With the Raptor, I can pull that off...!
First, I'll stop you in your tracks!
Here goes, Maneuver RaMVs!/　RT Arrange!
Same trick as the Sonic Breaker!
All-out attack! I can do this!
With the Raptor and Bison combination!
This thing is the Tesla Drive itself!/　You can't dodge it!!
G-Impact Cannon, all barrels on standby!
Show 'em what you've got, streamlined body.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Did too many G's make you that way?
I pull maneuvers like this all the time!
I'll hit it with everything Type-2 has...!
I'll finish you in one blow!
This power... It really is a one-hit kill!
I'll draw out every bit of this weapon's potential...!
I'll bring it into my range!
Here I go! Super Sonic Breaker!
I'll hold out...! I can do it too!
I'll keep coming at you as many times as it takes!
This is the moment of truth...!
Pin it down, then corner it!
It's my chance! All at once!
